description: Two-phase flow simulations of fixed 3D oscillating water columns using OpenFOAM is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Zhenhua Huang, University of Hawaii Manoa (hawaii.edu). This project is a numerical study of a pile integrated with an oscillating water column (OWC), we call it an OWC-pile. A row of OWC piles can form a dual-function structure for wave energy utilization and control of beach erosion caused by waves reaching the shoreline. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Breakwater. Published 2021-11-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
